method: Read visible Serial monitor DMG_FRAME values and observation timestamps through browser UI. Same cloud Chrome tab, Circuit view, Preview mode, MCU Serial inspector, no 3D renderer available. Start game using an actual 1500 ms A button hold.

input_proof.meaning: Actual A press and release reached the emulated game; both samples show phase=1 and increasing score.

limitations: Single sequential observation windows, not repeated controlled benchmark.
Different segments of the same game trajectory; baseline was already warm after several idle minutes, candidate booted recently.
Timestamps were captured immediately before the visible DOM read; IPC and snapshot cadence add observation uncertainty.
This measures firmware game progression, not rasterized display FPS or input latency.
Cloud browser could not initialize WebGL2, so no 3D/CAD performance claim.
User-device performance depends on host CPU/GPU and simultaneous workload.
Workstation 3D benchmark connection failed; not substituted with these Circuit numbers.
conclusion: Candidate improves actual browser game progression in this observed Circuit run, from approximately5.5 to18.6 game frames/s. Exact deterministic compute-budget and pixel-equivalence checks are reported separately.
